 M4 traffic RECAP: Rush hour chaos as all traffic held on major motorway after crash
 Emergency services are in attendance.
 Share Article Share Article Facebook X LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Email Copy Link Link copied Add us as preferred source live By  Astha Saxena , News Reporter, Robert Dalling 08:49, Fri, Oct 30, 2026 Updated: 11:07, Fri, Oct 30, 2026 
 Emergency services are in attendance (Image: TRAFFIC WALES) A collision prompted major traffic disruption on the M4 during rush hour. All traffic was temporarily held at 6.40am and traffic cameras showed stationary traffic due to the crash on M4 eastbound between junction 24 A449 (Coldra) and junction 23A A4810 (Magor services). Traffic Wales said emergency services were in attendance. Congestion started to ease before 9am.

 Traffic moving slow at M4. (Image: TRAFFIC CAMERAS) 2 days ago 07:48 Astha Saxena How many lanes are closed?
 Traffic monitoring service Inrix says two lanes are closed due to the incident.
 2 days ago 07:44 Astha Saxena Traffic cameras show delays
 Traffic cameras show vehicles queuing up on the motorway. 
 Traffic on M4 (Image: TRAFFIC CAMERAS) 2 days ago 07:40 Astha Saxena What do we know so far?
 All traffic is being temporarily held and there's stationary traffic due to the incident on M4 eastbound between junction 24 A449 (Coldra) and junction 23A A4810 (Magor services).
